text: The applicant appealed its zoning by-law amendment application and site plan control application to the Ontario Land Tribunal (the "Tribunal") on April 7, 2022. The Tribunal has scheduled the first case management conference in this matter for August 4, 2022. The Tribunal's rules expect parties to the appeal to be prepared with issues in respect of the appeal by the first case management conference. The applicant has gone on the public record indicating their willingness to mediate the appeals. Further direction from City Council is required on this matter.

City Council on July 19, 20, 21 and 22, 2022, adopted the following: 1. City Council adopt the confidential instructions to staff in Confidential Attachment 1 to the report (July 5, 2022) from the City Solicitor. 2. City Council authorize the public release of the confidential instructions to staff in Confidential Attachment 1 to the report (July 5, 2022) from the City Solicitor. 3. City Council direct that the balance of Confidential Attachment 1 to the report (July 5, 2022) from the City Solicitor remain confidential at the discretion of the City Solicitor, as it contains advice that is subject to solicitor-client privilege.
